title: Tuna, Butter Bean and Courgette Ribbon Salad
changes_from_base: Mayonnaise and celery are dropped: a lemon-shallot vinaigrette dresses the tuna with butter beans and salted courgette ribbons.
summary: A light, mayonnaise-free tuna salad: chunks of oil-packed tuna, creamy butter beans and silky salted courgette ribbons in a lemon-shallot vinaigrette with soft herbs.
equipment: salad spinner or clean tea towel

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt, for the courgettes (liquid discarded)
fine sea salt or table salt
canned butter beans, rinsed and dried (one 400 g tin)
oil-packed tuna, drained and flaked into chunks

steps.title: Salt the ribbons
steps.text: Shave the courgettes lengthways into ribbons, toss with the salt in a colander and leave 15 min.

steps.title: Pickle the shallot
steps.text: Meanwhile, whisk the shallot, lemon zest and juice, garlic, salt and pepper and leave 15 min, then whisk in the oil and herbs.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Spin or blot the courgettes dry, then fold them with the beans and tuna through the dressing.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave 20-30 min at room temperature, then serve with lemon wedges and a little extra oil.

tips: Good oil-packed tuna makes a real difference here.
Dry the beans and courgettes well so the dressing clings.
Rest at room temperature before serving.
storage: Best eaten on the day. Keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
